integrity: Complete self-contained proof conditional only on explicitly cited published result; finite exact checks are supporting evidence, not proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to fixed composite modulus p and consecutive generators a,a+1 with a>p. Uses Liu's published complete residue-class formula; broader semigroup quotients not addressed. Historical priority of exact composite-period noncollapse remains provisional.
title: No quasipolynomial period collapse for composite quotients of consecutive-generator numerical semigroups
